classification.difficultyReason: The hardest figures require choosing intermediate angles, combining alternate-segment relationships with triangle sums, and transferring the result to another tangent angle without a supplied route.

content.prompt: Find the value of the pronumeral. You do not need to give reasoning.

spec.description: Four radii and two chords with external 6 cm leaders; centre O, central 50° and x.
spec.mathematics: Equal 6 cm chords subtend equal central angles.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 50° is visible; the answer is omitted.

answer.worked:
Equal chords subtend equal angles at the centre.
$$x=50^\circ$$

spec.description: Diameter through O, two downward radii, equal 40 cm chords, 70° between downward radii and x beside the right diameter radius.
spec.mathematics: Equal central angles either side of 70° sum with it to 180°.

answer.worked:
The two 40 cm chords subtend equal angles at the centre. Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}2x+70^\circ&=180^\circ\\2x&=110^\circ\\x&=55^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Inscribed triangle, three radii, equal 10 cm sloping chords and central 110°.
spec.mathematics: The two remaining central angles are equal and total 250°.

answer.worked:
Equal chords subtend equal angles at the centre. Angles around a point sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}2x+110^\circ&=360^\circ\\2x&=250^\circ\\x&=125^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: 48° circumference angle and corresponding central x, with centre O.
spec.mathematics: Centre angle is twice the circumference angle on the same arc.

answer.worked:
The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference on the same arc.
$$\begin{aligned}x&=2\times48^\circ\\x&=96^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Horizontal chord below O, bottom vertex, given 23° at right and central x.
spec.mathematics: The angle x subtends the same arc as 23°.

answer.worked:
The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference on the same arc.
$$\begin{aligned}x&=2\times23^\circ\\x&=46^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Diameter through O, chord to right-upper point and its radius; given 35° at the upper-left endpoint.
spec.mathematics: The central angle x subtends the same arc as the 35° circumference angle.

answer.worked:
The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference on the same arc.
$$\begin{aligned}x&=2\times35^\circ\\x&=70^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Top horizontal tangent of length x to an external point; secant external 4 cm and internal 5 cm.
spec.mathematics: Tangent squared equals 4 times the whole secant, 4+5.

spec.description: Bottom horizontal tangent 10 cm; diagonal secant with external 4 cm and internal x.
Top tangent labelled √32 cm; equal-length single ticks on internal and external secant segments; external segment x.
spec.mathematics: Both secant segments equal x, so 32=x(2x).

answer.worked:
The marked secant segments are equal, so the whole secant is $2x$. Tangent–secant product rule:
$$\begin{aligned}(\sqrt{32})^2&=x(2x)\\32&=2x^2\\x^2&=16\\x&=4\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Four chords connecting top, left, bottom and right vertices, with 25°, 35°, x and y at their source vertices.
spec.mathematics: x and 35° stand on the same arc; y and 25° stand on the same arc.

answer.worked:
Angles at the circumference standing on the same arc are equal.
$$x=35^\circ$$
$$y=25^\circ$$

spec.description: Crossing chords with x at upper-left and 140° at lower-left, both sharing the top and bottom-right endpoints.
spec.mathematics: The two circumference angles stand on the same arc.

answer.worked:
Angles at the circumference standing on the same arc are equal.
$$x=140^\circ$$

spec.description: Two side chords and crossing diagonals; 60° at lower-left, 100° in the upper crossing sector, x at upper-right.
spec.mathematics: Adjacent crossing angle is 80°; the left triangle's upper angle is 40°, equal to x on the same arc.
spec.answerVisibility: 40° is answer-only; E is an unprinted construction coordinate.

answer.worked:
The angle at the intersection inside the left triangle is $180^\circ-100^\circ=80^\circ$. Its upper angle is $180^\circ-60^\circ-80^\circ=40^\circ$. This angle and $x$ stand on the same arc.
$$x=40^\circ$$

spec.description: Triangle with a diameter through O and bottom tangent; given 48° at left. The x arc spans from the rightward tangent to the left chord, passing across the right chord.
spec.mathematics: Bottom triangle angle is 90°; right-chord/right-tangent angle is 48°, so the full x sector is 138°.

answer.worked:
The angle in the semicircle is $90^\circ$. By the alternate segment theorem, the angle between the right chord and the rightward tangent is $48^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}x&=90^\circ+48^\circ\\x&=138^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Inscribed triangle with tangents at top-right and lower-left; tangent/chord givens 70° and 85°, x at the third vertex.
spec.mathematics: Alternate segment theorem gives triangle angles 70° and 85°; x=25°.

answer.worked:
By the alternate segment theorem, the lower-left triangle angle is $70^\circ$ and the top triangle angle is $85^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}x+70^\circ+85^\circ&=180^\circ\\x&=25^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Triangle with horizontal top tangent and oblique lower-left tangent; interior 75°, encompassing lower-left 120° sector and top-left tangent/chord x.
spec.mathematics: The smaller lower tangent/chord angle is 45°, giving top triangle angle 45°; remaining triangle angle and x are 60°.

answer.worked:
The angle between the lower chord and the lower-right tangent ray is $120^\circ-75^\circ=45^\circ$. By the alternate segment theorem, the top triangle angle is $45^\circ$. The lower-right triangle angle is $180^\circ-75^\circ-45^\circ=60^\circ$. By the alternate segment theorem,
$$x=60^\circ$$
